description: This file defines mock classes for IWebAudioPlayer and IWebAudioPlayerFactory interfaces used in testing. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for simulating WebAudioPlayer behavior in tests.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock class for IWebAudioPlayerFactory interface, used to create mock WebAudioPlayer instances.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerMock
classes.description: Mock class for IWebAudioPlayer interface, providing mock implementations of audio player methods for testing.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a mock WebAudioPlayer instance with specified client, mime type, priority, and config.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Simulates starting playback of the audio.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets the end of stream condition.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to the buffer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client associated with the WebAudioPlayer.
